name: STC-4424GCP-24BT.doc
method: soffice→docx→python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Model	STC-4424GCP-24BT
Product Name	28 port 10/100/1000Mbps Rack Type Ethernet BT PoE Switch
Fixed Port	24*10/100/1000Base-TX PoE port(Data/Power) / 4*1000M SFP/RJ45 COMBO
PoE Ports	1-24 port supports IEEE802.3af/at/poe++/bt, max 90W PoE out
PoE Pin	af/at/poe++/bt: 12+ 45+ 36- 78-
PoE Budget	Max 800W
Bandwidth	56Gbps
Packet Forwarding	41.67Mpps
MAC	8K
Buffer	4.1M
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter) / 1000BASE-TX: Cat6 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media	SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module, Max distance≤100Km
LED Indicator	PWR: Power LED(green) / 1-24: 10/100/1000M Network connection indicator(green) / 25-28: 10/100/1000M Network connection indicator(green) / PoE: PoE indicator(orange)
Power	Built-in power AC: 100-240VAC 50-60Hz
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-10°C～+55°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 440mm*290mm*45mm / Packing Box: 515mm*375mm*95mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	3.9Kg/4.8Kg
Lightning / Protection Level	6KV 8/20us / IP30
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty	1 Year
